variants.name: ترف المساء
variants.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset: ONE individual full-body Saudi female employee avatar for the existing app, matching its polished realistic 3D illustration.
INPUTS: image 1 existing app avatar-02: use only woman identity/eyes, pose, proportions, royal BLUE sleeveless open work vest, pockets/curved corners and BOTH exact IVORY NIKE VOMERO 5 mesh sneakers as invariants. Replace abaya and niqab. Image 2 EXACT company brand artwork. Image 3 user's three-photo NIQAB COLLAGE is the overriding headwear standard. Image 4 selected original niqab photo from that collage. Image 5 Saudi store ABAYA reference to faithfully reproduce, with distinct details.
PRIMARY USER CORRECTIONS: abaya must be NEITHER TIGHT NOR EXCESSIVELY WIDE. Use normal Saudi retail abaya ease: balanced straight/moderately falling silhouette, natural small drape, ordinary shoulders, normal sleeves, no fitted waist, no belt, NO broad cloche skirt, NO enormous bell/wing/batwing sleeves, NO spreading tent at hem. Follow the actual garment reference's distinct construction and decorative details as visible beneath the original blue work vest. Do not duplicate another design or just recolor.
NIQAB: faithfully copy the SINGLE HANGING CLOTH face veil and the straight forehead band in selected photo4, constrained to photo3 collage. Simple authentic Saudi niqab with natural eye opening and face veil hanging freely around jaw to upper chest. Restrained variation only as present in the THREE photos. NO invented shape, NO pointed/triangular hem, NO double-overlapping face panels, NO new headwrap, NO turban, NO surgical/contoured mask. No metallic burqa. No forehead emblem, logos or extra ornaments. Match cap/band/niqab/scarf base color EXACTLY to abaya.
LOGO: faithfully transfer exact provided image2 artwork, SMALL at the vest's left chest (viewer right): red "I am" on first line, lowercase "special" on second; yellow brushstroke, yellow pencil on left, colorful red/blue/green/yellow puzzle on right. Correct original aspect ratio. Remove ONLY the surrounding WHITE; retain yellow brushstroke within artwork. No white rectangular badge. No invented lettering.
FRAME: one woman standing relaxed, entire head to both complete shoes, same scale and three-quarter view as image1. Hands correct, pose unchanged. Hem ends above sneakers so both Nike Vomero 5 models visible. Crisp actual transparent alpha background, no floor, no ambient glows, no outside shadow, no halo, no labels, no captions or watermarks. Output only ONE full-body avatar.
Abaya A: BLACK soft matte crepe. Reproduce image5's distinctive DENSE BLACK HAND-EMBROIDERED broad cuff zones on ordinary moderately straight sleeves, subtly gathered sleeve attachment and clean unadorned snap-front long skirt. Cuff embroidery dense textured tonal black, no silver vines, no lace or scattered pearls. Moderate regular silhouette, no flare. Niqab from photo4 (right panel of collage): fitted straight forehead band, narrow horizontal eye opening, simple long straight hanging black face panel.
